fields.help_en:
The configuration of the resource group.
CpuRateLimit: the percentage of CPU resources available to the resource group. Unit: %.
MemoryLimit: the percentage of memory resources available to the resource group. Unit: %.
MemorySharedQuota: the percentage of memory resources shared among transactions submitted to the resource group. Unit: %. Default value: 80.
MemorySpillRatio: the memory usage threshold for memory-intensive transactions. When a transaction reaches this threshold, it spills to disk. Unit: %. Default value: 0.
Concurrency: the maximum concurrency allowed for the resource group. Default value: 20
fields.help_zh:
资源组配置。
CpuRateLimit：资源组可使用cpu资源百分比，单位：%
MemoryLimit：资源组可使用内存资源百分比，单位：%
MemorySharedQuota：提交到该资源组的事务之间共享的内存资源百分比，单位：%，默认值：80
MemorySpillRatio：内存密集型事务的内存使用阈值。当事务达到此阈值时，将溢出磁盘，单位：%，默认值：0
Concurrency：资源组允许的最大并发数，默认值：20
